==Biography==

===Season 2013-2014===
Tockers was the mid laner for the  [[Afterall Gaming]] squad when the team was bought by the [[AceZone e-Sports]] organization in November 2013. He won some minor tournaments like the G-Cup Gamepolitan 2014, but the team was  unable to find good results on major tournaments like BGL Arena 2014 and did not qualify for the [[IEM Season VIII - Sao Paulo|IEM São Paulo 2014]].

Tockers left the [[AceZone]] organization in April 2014 and created the team "Sexy sem ser Vulgar" (later renamed to [[Ban Karma Gaming]]) alongside his friends in order to participate on the  [[2014 Season Brazil Regional Finals]], but he left the team after the qualifiers.

On June 2014 tockers and [[Yang (Felipe Zhao)|Yang]] joined the new [[INTZ|INTZ eSports]] team, alongside [[MicaO]], [[Djokovic]], and [[Jockster]], quickly growing into one of the best Brazilian teams and winning major tournaments  like [[Circuito Game7]]  without losing a single game.

===2015 Season===
In the [[INTZ]] dominance over the regular season of the first [[CBLOL/2015 Season|CBLOL 2015]] split, he was one of their main carries, quickly developing into one of the best Brazilian mid laners,  facing Brazilian legends like [[Kami (Gabriel Bohm Santos)|Kami]] and [[Takeshi]] without any kind of fear.

===2016 Season===
In 2016 he was part of the lineup that is often referred as the Exodia of CBLOL: [[Yang (Felipe Zhao)|Yang]], [[Revolta]], [[tockers]], [[micaO]] and [[Jockster]], led by [[Peter Dun]] and [[Abaxial]]. The team managed to never lose a series that they played on Brazilian soil. They played at [[CBLOL 2016 Split 1]] and consequently won [[CBLOL 2016 Split 1 Playoffs]] after beating [[Keyd Stars]] for 3x0 in the Grand Finals. With the win, they classified [[INTZ]] to the [[2016 International Wildcard Invitational]], where they managed to achieve 3rd place among other Wildcards regions.
In the [[CBLOL 2016 Split 2|second split]], they found theyselves in a rivalry against [[CNB e-Sports Club]] until they beated them by 3-1 in the [[CBLOL 2016 Split 2 Playoffs|finals]]. In the [[IWCQ 2016]], they managed to classify to [[Worlds 2016]], where they made history by being the only Brazilian team to defeat an Asian team from a Major league by defeating [[EDward Gaming]], despite not qualifying for the main stage of the tournament.<ref>[https://www.espn.com.br/esports/artigo/_/id/5732003/adeus-exodia-o-fim-e-o-legado-do-quinteto-mais-vitorioso-do-cblol Adeus, Exodia: o fim e o legado do quinteto mais vitorioso do CBLoL]''espn.com.br''</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Was known as an {{ci|Anivia}} OTP early in his career.
* Usually pulled out bans agains his assassins, mostly {{ci|Zed}} and {{ci|Kassadin}}.
* Loves pizza.
* Portrayed as {{ci|Azir}} in the CBLOL 2015 official wallpaper.
* Claims that [[Revolta]] changed the mindset of [[INTZ]] making his teammates to think about being the best, not just a good team.
* Credits the huge improvement of INTZ to the fact that him, [[Yang (Felipe Zhao)|Yang]] and [[Jockster]] reached micaO's level.
* Is a very close friend of [[Peter Dun]], who he considers one of his biggest mentors in the competitive scene.
* He revealed in a interview that he received offers to play for [[Team Liquid]] in 2017, but refused them at the time. <ref>[https://maisesports.com.br/lol-tockers-recebeu-proposta-da-team-liquid-e-explica-o-porque-nao-foi/ LoL: Tockers já recebeu proposta da Team Liquid e explica o porque não foi (Portuguese)] ''maisesports.com.br''</ref> He claimed in other interview that if he could change something about his career he would maybe have accepted the offer. <ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oKmroVSSaqk Face Check 004 - TOCKERS (Portuguese)]''youtube.com''</ref>
* Despite retiring from League in 2020, he decided to compete in Valorant in 2023, but retired again in August of the same year.
* He decided to return to making League content in late 2023, and eventually even played the [[CBLOL Academy/2024 Season/Split 1 Qualifiers|CBLOL Academy Qualifiers]] in the following year for [[Ilha das Lendas]].
* In [[CBLOL 2024 Split 1]] he got invited to cast a few games and was a invited caster in '''CBLOL''' despite not officially working for '''Riot Games Brazil'''.
